name: Two Weeks
source:
You play as a young student, due to a difficult divorce you ended up living with your father.
Your father had to leave the country because of his work, so you barely see anymore your mother and sister. Usually, you spend two weeks each summer in your mother's house but last year you couldn't make it due to the amount of work you had to do to pass succesully your exams. After two years you finally see them again and a lot of things has changed.
This is the first day.​

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/madek]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你將扮演一名年輕學生。父母經歷了一場艱難的離婚後，你跟父親一起生活。
父親因工作必須出國，你也因此幾乎見不到母親和姊妹。通常，你每年夏天都會去母親家住兩週，但去年為了通過考試，你有太多功課要做，沒能成行。時隔兩年，你終於再次見到她們，而許多事情都已改變。
今天，是重逢的第一天。

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/madek]Patreon[/url]]
